queueIntro: Verify eligibility at expert level, then assess competency for each requested service. Final approval belongs to System Admin.
demo: Demo · Synthetic applications and evidence. Drafts and decisions stay in memory and reset on reload. No server changes or real permissions are implied.
search: Find an applicant, application or service…
resetConfirm: Reset demo drafts and decision history?
unavailableBody: This portal currently supports explicit demo mode only. Real access must be verified using permissions and application assignments by the server.
noReviewsBody: Try another search or clear the stage and status filters.
notFoundBody: The application is not assigned to this reviewer or does not belong to this review stage.
gate1Intro: Check each eligibility requirement against supporting evidence. Your decision applies to this expert application, not to an individual service.
gate2Intro: Assess each competency criterion for the expert’s registered service. Decisions never apply automatically to another service.
evidenceIntro: Synthetic text extracts only. No uploaded documents or download API are available in this preview.
flagsResolved: I reviewed the flagged discrepancies and documented their resolution in the decision note.
criteriaPendingBody: Competency criteria are not fully configured. You can save evidence and assessment notes, but cannot submit a competency decision yet.
notePlaceholder: Explain your finding and cite the selected evidence…
decisionIntro: Record the human decision and its basis. AI flags cannot determine the outcome.
decisionPlaceholder: State your basis. For missing information, identify what must be supplied; for rejection, explain the failed requirement and relevant new evidence.
draftSaved: Draft saved in memory only. Reloading clears this draft.
decisionSaved: Demo decision recorded. No server record was changed.
handoff: Competency requirements met. This service qualification awaits administrator approval before it can appear on the marketplace.
cooldown: Earliest reapplication: {{date}}. New or updated evidence is required; this decision remains in history.
sameApplication: More information requested in the same application and review stage.
discardBody: Unsaved assessment changes will be discarded. Save your demo draft to retain them during this session.
historyIntro: Append-only decisions with reviewer, policy version, evidence references and timestamps. Final approval is outside the Reviewer workspace.
noHistoryBody: Complete a demo eligibility review to see its assessment record here.

errors.permission: Review permission and assignment are required. This preview is read-only.
errors.closed: This review is closed. Historical decisions cannot be overwritten.
errors.gate1Required: Verify eligibility before assessing competency for this service.
errors.policyMissing: Configure the criteria before submitting a competency decision.
errors.incomplete: Complete each result, evidence reference and assessment note, then add a decision and rationale.
errors.invalidDecision: The decision must match the assessment results: pass requires all requirements met; rejection requires a failed requirement; an information request requires insufficient evidence without a confirmed failure.
errors.experience: Experience is below the policy threshold. Mark Tax and accounting experience as not met and choose Not eligible when the declared years are verified.
errors.evidence: An evidence reference is unavailable. Select evidence from this application.
errors.flags: Verify and resolve the flagged discrepancies before passing the application.
